contexts.text: See Flax.
Behold a furnace of smoke () = most dense falsity.
Such a man appears as a furnace, and the falsity from hatreds as smoke.
Smoke = Falsities. Illustrated.
The smoke which is from the fire = the falsity which is from the cupidities. Illustrated.
The smoke of the land as the smoke of a furnace () = the state of falsity from the state of evil within the Church. AC 7519:7.
Smoke from the north () = falsity from Hell. Smoke = falsity from evil.
Like smoke which vanishes.
Smoking firebrands () = wrath. ( = concupiscence of falsity, and the derivative wrath against the truths and goods of the Church. AE 559:8.)
Mount Sinai smoked () = the appearing of heavenly good in the greatest obscurity. Explained.
That smoke = what is obscure of truth, and also the thick darkness which is of falsity. Illustrated. AC 8916:2.
Its smoke went up as the smoke of a furnace () = an obscureness like that from cupidities.
The mountain smoking () = good of truth not perceptible except in the external form. Explained.

The state of an evil man, when angry, is circumstanced like smoke, which on the application of fire conceives flame; for the falsity of evil in the Intellectual is like smoke; and anger is like the flame of the kindled smoke. Hence smoke = falsity. Illustrated.
A smoke, etc. () = the veiling over of truth Divine, thus its accommodation. AC 10198:2. AE 594:15.
See Incense. AR 394. AE 494.
Near the end of our solar system there appeared... a fiery smoke...
The fiery smoke seized on some Spirits who wanted to cross, and tortured them. A fiery smoke is falsity from the evils of concupiscences.
The smoke which filled the tabernacle = Divine truth in ultimates, such as is the sense of the letter.
For the smoke, and thence the fumigation (of the incense) = that which is elevated on high; and the odour of the smoke, that which is grateful...
Appear like smokiness from a furnace.
Smoke = falsity from evil.
When the Hells are opened, there appears a fieriness with smoke.
Smoke and soot = falsities from these evils.
See Last Judgment. LJ 61:6. SE 5257. SE 5267. SE 5334. SE 5418. SE 5636. SE 5650.
These exercises ascend... but fall down again, like smoke in the air.
Smoke like that of a conflagration surrounds him... I have seen that smoke about the Hells of such.
A smoke out of the pit as the smoke of a great furnace () = falsities of concupiscences gushing from their evil loves. AR 422:2, Illustrated.
Outside the Hells (their love) appears as the smoke of a conflagration, or as the smoke of a furnace.

Out of their mouths issued smoke, etc. () = in their thoughts and discourse nothing but the conceit of Own intelligence, etc... This goes forth from the love of self and of the world as smoke does from fire. AR 453.
A pestilential smoke ascended from the Jerusalem which is called Sodom and Egypt.
The smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever () = the conceit of Own intelligence, and torment in Hell from it.

The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God... () = the inmost of Heaven full of Divine spiritual and celestial truth from the Lord. Smoke = the Divine in ultimates, because the fire from which is the smoke = love. Illustrated.
Smoke, in the opposite, = the falsities of concupiscences; and the falsities which originate from the conceit of Own intelligence. Smoke, moreover, = the same as cloud in many places.
The smoke of her burning () = these falsities. ( = damnation on account of the adulteration and profanation of the Word. AR 787.)
Her smoke goeth up for ever and ever () = that this profane religiosity has been damned to eternity.
The antechamber was filled with an aromatic smoke, a sign of blessing from Heaven.
From the devil's mouth belched smoke like a furnace.
His prayer ascends towards Heaven like the smoke of a conflagration which is driven back by a tempest into his eyes.
I saw, below, a great smoke... The smoke seen in the Hells arises from falsities confirmed by reasonings.

Flame is nothing but smoke set on fire... for I have seen smoke rising from the wood in the fireplace, and when I applied fire to it, I saw that smoke turned into flame... for the particles of smoke become little sparks, and they all blaze together. So the smoke we see below consists of as many falsities.
Many of them were so enraged that smoke and fire came out of their nostrils.
When left to himself, smoke rose up from Hell and extinguished the lucidity above his memory... and the smoke, ignited, burned like a flame, and illuminated the region below his memory.
A black smoke flowed down from a ruined chimney.
Smoke of a furnace mixed with sulphureous fire.
They threw themselves forth with smoke.
Smoke of a furnace = falsity from evil. AE 539.
Smoke = the dense falsity which flows forth from evil. Fully illustrated.
Smoke = holy truth.
Smoke = dense falsity. AE 541.
Smoke = infernal falsity. AE 1131.
Smoke = dense falsity gushing forth from the love of evil.
Smoke = falsity of evil. AE 1204.
Smoke = dense falsity flowing forth from the Hells from the evils of the earthly and corporeal loves which are with those who are there. AE 1173.
Smoke = the understanding of the Word in the natural sense. Explained.
The smokes which appear over the Hells are the falsities which come from them.
Scripture sayings by which truths are confirmed ascend into Heaven; they are like smoke from a censer.
